A '''[[lake]]''' on the forest moon of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] bore a mystical enchantment. Anyone who touched the water was magically teleported under the surface and trapped by a force field that only magical objects could penetrate. [[Mace Towani]] stumbled onto this lake and became trapped. He pounded helplessly on the surface of the water and shouted for help. [[Cindel Towani]] and her [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] companions came to his aid, and eventually [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] was able to rescue him by piercing the magic barrier with his magic walking stick.
